candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that credits the recipient's imBalances after depositing.
Credit the caller's own imBalances instead of the designated recipient `to`.
Change the balance update from accumulation (`+=`) to assignment (`=`), wiping any existing balance.
Accumulate the deposited mAsset amount directly instead of the credits issued by the savings contract.
Remove `_status = _ENTERED;` so the guard never marks entry, allowing reentrant supplyTokenTo calls that double-credit a key's imBalances.
Approve an allowance of 0 instead of type(uint256).max to the savings contract.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can invoke approveMax.
Check tx.origin instead of msg.sender in the onlyOwner guard.
Emit the contract's own address instead of msg.sender in the ApprovedMax event.
